title: HackerRank: Solve Me First
description: Complete the function `solve_me_first` to compute the sum of two integers `a` and `b`.
starter_code:
def solve_me_first(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def solve_me_first(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b
explanation: Returns arithmetic sum of two integers.
